source_refs.note: Exercise 8.4, Question 5 (book p. 253); answer key p. 307 (PDF 309).

blocks.prompt: 5. In a secure communication system, the phase shift \(\theta\) (in radians) of an encrypted signal is modeled by the nonlinear function \(f(\theta) = \sin\theta - 0.5\). For proper synchronization of the encrypted signal, the phase shift must satisfy \(f(\theta) = 0\). Use the Newton-Raphson Method with initial guess \(\theta_0 = 0.5\) to determine the required phase shift \(\theta\), correct to three decimal places.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh asal mein sin(theta) = 0.5 hai, jise hum numerically hal kar rahe hain; theta radians mein hai.
Diya kya hai? f aur shuruati guess 0.5. Find kya karna hai? Theta, teen decimal places tak.
Rule kaunsa? Newton-Raphson, jis mein f'(theta) = cos(theta).
Plan: calculator radian mode mein, 5 places ke saath iterations, aur do lagataar values 0.0005 se kam farq par rukna.
Aakhir mein exact jawab pi/6 se milana.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(f(\theta) = \sin\theta - 0.5\), \(\theta_0 = 0.5\).
Maloom karna: root \(\theta\), teen decimal places tak.
Tareeqa: Newton-Raphson \(\theta_{n+1} = \theta_n - \frac{f(\theta_n)}{f'(\theta_n)}\), calculator radian mode mein.

Derivative
\[f'(\theta) = \cos\theta\]
Kyun: \(\sin\theta\) ka derivative \(\cos\theta\) aur constant ka zero. Yeh formula sirf radians mein sahi hai. \(\theta_0 = 0.5\) ke qareeb \(\cos\theta \approx 0.88 \ne 0\), to method lag sakta hai.
Dhyan dein: degree mode mein sin 0.5 = 0.0087 aata hai aur saara hisaab bigar jata hai.

Iteration 1: theta_0 = 0.5
\[f(0.5) = 0.47943 - 0.5 = -0.02057\]
\[f'(0.5) = \cos 0.5 = 0.87758\]
\[\theta_1 = 0.5 + \dfrac{0.02057}{0.87758}\]
\[= 0.5 + 0.02344 = 0.52344\]
Kyun: f(0.5) negative hai, minus aur minus mil kar plus, is liye theta barh gaya, root ki taraf.

Iteration 2: theta_1 = 0.52344
\[f(0.52344) = 0.49986 - 0.5 = -0.00014\]
\[f'(0.52344) = 0.86610\]
\[\theta_2 = 0.52344 + \dfrac{0.00014}{0.86610}\]
\[= 0.52360\]
Kyun: \(|\theta_2 - \theta_1| = 0.00016 < 0.0005\).
Dhyan dein: \(\theta_1\) par \(|f| = 0.00014\) pehle hi 0.0005 se kam tha, lekin wahan rukte to 0.52344 se 0.523 banta, jo teesre decimal mein ghalat hai. Newton-Raphson mein do lagataar values ka milna bhi zaroori hai.

Iteration 3
\[f(0.52360) \approx 0.00000\]
\[\theta_3 = 0.52360\]
Kyun: do lagataar values bilkul ek jaisi, is liye \(\theta \approx 0.524\).

Tasdeeq
\[f(0.5235) = -0.00009 < 0\]
\[f(0.5245) = 0.00078 > 0\]
Root \(]0.5235, 0.5245[\) mein hai aur 0.524 par round hota hai. Exact: \(\sin\theta = \frac{1}{2}\) se \(\theta = \frac{\pi}{6} = 0.5235988\) rad \(= 30^{\circ}\).
Kyun: hum pehle se jaante hain ke sin 30 degree = 1/2, aur numerical jawab isi se milta hai; yeh method par bharosa barhata hai.
